arxiv-2202-02780.title: A conjecture of Sárközy on quadratic residues. II
arxiv-2202-02780.creator: Yong-Gao Chen, Ping Xi
arxiv-2202-02780.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yong-Gao Chen, Ping Xi. Denote by ℛ p \mathcal{R}_{p} the set of all quadratic residues in 𝔽 p \mathbb{F}_{p} for each prime p p . Sárközy asserts, for all sufficiently large p p , that no subsets 𝒜 , ℬ ⊆ 𝔽 p \mathcal{A},\mathcal{B}\subseteq\mathbb{F}_{p} with | 𝒜 | , | ℬ | ⩾ 2 |\mathcal{A}|,|\mathcal{B}|\geqslant 2 satisfy 𝒜 + ℬ = ℛ p \mathcal{A}+\mathcal{B}=\mathcal{R}_{p} .

arxiv-2306-04808.creator: J.E. Parkkila for the ALICE Collaboration
arxiv-2306-04808.description: Abstract In these proceedings, the measurements of the long-range near-side yields of charged hadrons in low-multiplicity proton–proton collisions at s = 13 ​ TeV \sqrt{s}=13\,\mathrm{TeV} are presented. The investigation studies pairs of charged particles within 1.4 < | Δ ​ η | < 1.8 1.4<|\Delta\eta|<1.

arxiv-2310-08694.title: The intermediate neutron capture process
arxiv-2310-08694.creator: Sébastien Martinet, Arthur Choplin, Stephane Goriely, Lionel Siess
arxiv-2310-08694.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sébastien Martinet, Arthur Choplin, Stephane Goriely, Lionel Siess. The observed surface abundance distributions of Carbon-enhanced metal-poor (CEMP) r/s-stars suggest that these stars could have been polluted by an intermediate neutron-capture process (the so-called i-process) occurring at intermediate neutron densities between the r- and s-processes. Triggered by the ingestion of protons inside a convective He-burning zone, the i-process could be hosted in several sites, a promising one being the early AGB phase of low-mass low-metallicity stars.

arxiv-2408-12886.description: Abstract . Stochastic large scale interacting systems can be studied via the observables, i.e. functions on the underlying configuration space. In our previous article, we introduced the concept of uniform functions , which are suitable class of functions on configuration spaces underlying stochastic systems on infinite graphs.

arxiv-2411-19940.title: Direct local parametrization of nuclear state densities using the back-shifted Bethe formula
arxiv-2411-19940.creator: C. Özen, Y. Alhassid
arxiv-2411-19940.description: Abstract Level densities are often parametrized using the back-shifted Bethe formula (BBF) for nuclei that possess experimental data for s-wave neutron resonance average spacings and a complete discrete level sequence at low excitation energies. However, these parametrizations require the additional modeling of the dependence of the spin-cutoff parameter on excitation energy.

arxiv-2504-00167.title: Enhancing Physical Human-Robot Interaction: Recognizing Digits via Intrinsic Robot Tactile Sensing Thanks: Citation : Authors. Title. Pages…. DOI:000000/11111.
arxiv-2504-00167.creator: Teresa Sinico, Giovanni Boschetti, Pedro Neto
arxiv-2504-00167.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Teresa Sinico, Giovanni Boschetti, Pedro Neto. Physical human-robot interaction (pHRI) remains a key challenge for achieving intuitive and safe interaction with robots. Current advancements often rely on external tactile sensors as interface, which increase the complexity of robotic systems. In this study, we leverage the intrinsic tactile sensing capabilities of collaborative robots to recognize digits drawn by humans on an uninstrumented touchpad mounted to the robot’s flange.

arxiv-2511-12113.title: MetaGDPO: Alleviating Catastrophic Forgetting with Metacognitive Knowledge through Group Direct Preference Optimization
arxiv-2511-12113.creator: Lanxue Zhang, Yuqiang Xie, Fang Fang Fanglong Dong, Rui Liu, Yanan Cao
arxiv-2511-12113.description: Abstract Large Language Models demonstrate strong reasoning capabilities, which can be effectively compressed into smaller models. However, existing datasets and fine-tuning approaches still face challenges that lead to catastrophic forgetting, particularly for models smaller than 8B. First, most datasets typically ignore the relationship between training data knowledge and the model’s inherent abilities, making it difficult to preserve prior knowledge.

pmc-10742020.title: In Vitro Organoid-Based Assays Reveal SMAD4 Tumor-Suppressive Mechanisms for Serrated Colorectal Cancer Invasion
pmc-10742020.creator: Kevin Tong, Manisha Bandari, Jillian N. Carrick, Anastasia Zenkevich, Om A. Kothari, Eman Shamshad, Katarina Stefanik, Katherine S. Haro, Ansu O. Perekatt, Michael P. Verzi
pmc-10742020.description: Simple SummaryBRAF-driven serrated colon cancers are among the most aggressive subsets of colorectal cancers. Smad4 is a critical tumor suppressor found mutated in many late-stage cancers, yet the role of Smad4 in serrated cancer invasion is still relatively understudied. This study seeks to address this gap by using organoids as an in vitro system for invasive behavior.

pmc-11434083.title: Deep Learning-Driven Prediction of Mechanical Properties of 316L Stainless Steel Metallographic by Laser Powder Bed Fusion
pmc-11434083.creator: Zhizhou Zhang, Paul Mativenga, Wenhua Zhang, Shi-qing Huang, Yuankun Lin
pmc-11434083.description: This study developed a new metallography–property relationship neural network (MPR-Net) to predict the relationship between the microstructure and mechanical properties of 316L stainless steel built by laser powder bed fusion (LPBF). The accuracy R2 of MPR-Net was 0.96 and 0.91 for tensile strength and Vickers hardness predictions, respectively, based on optical metallurgy images.

Virtual reality (VR) has emerged as an adjunctive tool to embed in social skills training to enhance the social skills of children with ADHD, but its effectiveness requires further investigation.

pmc-12380402.creator: Maria Chiara Del Piccolo, Ryan Hammoud, Maisie Khan, Vanessa Shanon D'Costa, Aljawharah Almuqrin, Anna Georgiades, Stefania Tognin, Andrea Mechelli, Taiane de Azevedo Cardoso

pmc-12476275.title: Initial Investigation of Vericiguat Efficacy in the Treatment of Recurrently Hospitalised Heart Failure Patients
pmc-12476275.creator: Aleksandrs Vasiljevs, Karlis Trusinskis
pmc-12476275.description: Introduction: Heart failure is a global health problem that has led to an increase in hospitalisations, a decrease in quality of life and an increase in premature death. Rehospitalisation due to worsening heart failure is an indicator of poor prognosis and is directly correlated with life expectancy. Furthermore, additional hospitalisations increase the financial burden on medical systems.

pmc-13130327.title: Parenteral clomipramine for depression or obsessive-compulsive disorder: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13130327.creator: Michael Ioannou, Örjan Falk, Joss Gustavsson, Johan Nilsson, Petteri Sjögren, Steinn Steingrimsson, Therese Svanberg, Zoltán Szabó, Susanna M Wallerstedt
pmc-13130327.description: In severe cases of depression and obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), clomipramine is sometimes administered parenterally. This systematic review aimed to investigate whether parenteral clomipramine is superior to oral clomipramine or other treatments, primarily in terms of reducing depressive/OCD symptoms within two weeks (CRD420250654029). Medline, Embase, the Cochrane Library, and PsycInfo were searched for relevant publications.

pmc-13536862.title: A standardized framework resolves ambiguity in motor neuron loss across neurodegenerative diseases
pmc-13536862.creator: Leonie Sowoidnich, Aaron L Norman, Florian Gerstner, Josiane K Siemund, Jannik M Buettner, John G Pagiazitis, Vanessa Dreilich, Konstantin Pilz, Dajun Tian, Charlotte J Sumner, Angela Paradis, George Z Mentis, Christian M Simon
pmc-13536862.description: Motor neuron (MN) loss is a hallmark of neurodegenerative disorders, yet its assessment remains variable, confounding mechanistic and therapeutic interpretation. To address this, we conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) mouse studies, revealing 60% variability in reported MN loss, for which spinal cord sampling emerged as a major contributor.
